## Appearance

Pacifique is a very lank, ragged, and homely youth. He has a round, brown face featuring striking black eyes.

## History

Pacifique Buote was a local acquaintance in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). During a stormy night when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's life hung in the balance due to typhoid fever, Pacifique received early news regarding his condition. The following morning, he met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the yard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to inform her that Gilbert's fever had broken and he would recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P1](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0001), [v3 ch.Revelation P4](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0004), [v3 ch.Revelation P5](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0005), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P7](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0007), [v3 ch.Revelation P8](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0008), +12 more_

## Quotes

> "I got de word las’ night dat my fader, he was seeck. It was so stormy dat I couldn’t go den, so I start vair early dis mornin’. I’m goin’ troo de woods for short cut."
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P23](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0023)

> "He got de turn las’ night. De doctor say he’ll be all right now dis soon while. Had close shave, dough! Dat boy, he jus’ keel himself at college. Well, I mus’ hurry. De old man, he’ll be in hurry to see me."
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)

> "He’s better,"
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)

> "Sure,"
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P23](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0023)

### [George Fletcher](../character/george-fletcher.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-fletcher--pacifique.md)

Pacifique works as a hired man for [George Fletcher](../character/george-fletcher.md) by Volume 3. During a stormy period when [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) lies critically ill with typhoid fever, Pacifique encounters [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the yard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to deliver the news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
